name: trstctl managed-key KMS/HSM custody runtime contract

served_path.entry: authenticated POST /api/v1/managed-keys on the shipped control-plane binary
served_path.flow: HTTP mutation -> tenant event -> PostgreSQL outbox -> separate signer ManageKey gRPC -> provider/device
served_path.idempotency: HTTP and signer operation identifiers are durable; an executing signer intent is reconciled against provider state after response loss or restart
served_path.effect_lanes: managedkey.command is partitioned by provider plus current key, or provider plus durable operation before a key exists

cloud_protocols.aws-kms: AWS JSON 1.1 KMS API with complete canonical SigV4 HMAC verification, atomic operation tag lookup, and terminal-state readback
cloud_protocols.azure-key-vault: Azure Key Vault/Managed HSM keys API with exact constant-time bearer authentication, deterministic operation key identity, and terminal-state readback
cloud_protocols.gcp-kms: Google Cloud KMS REST API with exact constant-time bearer authentication, deterministic operation resource identity, and terminal-state readback

hardware_protocols.pkcs11: cgo signer artifact plus deterministic operation CKA_ID and SoftHSM PKCS#11 object/sign/state readback
hardware_protocols.tpm2: go-tpm TPM 2.0 command transport plus swtpm full Public.AuthPolicy operation tag, foreign-handle collision, sign, and terminal absence readback
hardware_protocols.yubihsm2: Yubico PKCS#11 connector contract plus deterministic operation CKA_ID and independent PKCS#11 object/sign/state readback

completion: requires one receiver effect per durable operation across ambiguous response replay, two distinct provider keys, valid signatures, active/revoked/zeroized independent readback, and explicit private-key export denial
